record.notes: A refutation of a premise brief, which names 'Microsoft and AWS hackathon credits' as a thing to find. On this page there are none: the prize is gift cards and the platform cost sits with the entrant. The entry requirements quote the Agent Academy curriculum in three of the four criteria, which supports the second. What would change this record is a Microsoft hackathon whose rules include an Azure credit line; none was found in one search.
